power.neoorigins.wraith_hunger_drain.des: Ko te pupuri i to tinana ā-roto e whakawhiwhia ana ka wirihia e koe te hiakai 75% tere atu i te ritenga.
power.neoorigins.wraith_evolved_night_vi: Ka takahia e ou kanohi te pouri.
power.neoorigins.wraith_evolved_phase.de: Toga: haere i roto i ngā kōpaki mārō me te rere i te wā e whakatakotoria ana. 25% iti ake te hiakai. Ko te Obsidian me te toka e aukati tonu ana.
power.neoorigins.wraith_ascended_weaknes: Ko nga hoariri tata i roto i nga whare 3 e raru ana i te ngoikore.
power.neoorigins.wraith_ascended_dayligh: E tahu tonu ana te marama o te ra, engari i te haurua o te kaha.
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_phase.name: He puka ā-roto (Apex)
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_phase.descr: Toga: haere i roto i nga whare katoa, engari ko te toka me te rere i te wa e haere ana.
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_hunger_drai: Kua whakatūria tō puka ā-roto ka tere ake te hiakai i te 25% noa iho i te ritenga.
origins.neoorigins.skeleton.name: Ko te kōpaki
origins.neoorigins.skeleton.description: He putea hou o nga wheua tere, ngawari, me te mate ki te pere. He anga ngoikore, e kore e pa ki te ra, a ka taea anake te tango i nga waahanga kino rawa.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_undead.name: Ko te hunga mate
power.neoorigins.skeleton_undead.descrip: Ko koe te hunga mate, he kino ngā rongoā whakaora, he ora ngā rongoā kino, ā, he nui ake te kino o te pānga o te pāngarau ki a koe.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_water_breathin: Kāore e hiahia ana ki te manawa, ka ora tonu i raro i te wai.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_marksmanship.d: +2 te kino bonus ki nga patu pupuhi.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_speed.name: Ko te Maama o nga Rapu
power.neoorigins.skeleton_speed.descript: Ko ō wheua pōhēhē e hanga ana i a koe kia 20% tere ake i runga i ō waewae.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_jump.name: He taumaha ngawari
power.neoorigins.skeleton_jump.descripti: 30% te teitei ake i te ritenga.
Ko ō wheua ngoikore e whakaiti ana i tō hauora mōrahi ki te 7 ngā ngakau.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_daylight_damag: Ko te Rā i Whakapā Mai
Ka tahuna koe i te marama o te ra, ki te kore koe e mau i te potae.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_diet.name: Ko te kai kore wheua
power.neoorigins.skeleton_diet.descripti: Ka taea anake e koe te kai i te wheua wheua, te kikokiko pirau, me nga kanohi miro.
Ko te hiahia o nga wheua
He kai māu te kai o ngā wheua.
origins.neoorigins.slime.name: Ko te ngaru
origins.neoorigins.slime.description: Ko tētahi mea ora e hiahia ana kia noho mā te wai hei ora, ka hinga, ka wehe atu i te mate, ka pai te mātao, ka kaha ake i te wheako.
power.neoorigins.slime_moisture.name: Te ngenge
power.neoorigins.slime_moisture.descript: Kei a koe he pae humidity e rere ana i roto i te wa. E rere ana tere ake i roto i nga koraha me te wa e ahi ana. E tu ana i roto i te wai, i te ua ranei ki te whakahou i te wai. I runga ake i te 75%: Regen 1. I raro i te 10%: -4 whakangungu rakau. I te 0%: ka kino koe.
power.neoorigins.slime_death_save.name: Te wehewehe
power.neoorigins.slime_death_save.descri: Ka mate koe ki runga ake i te 75% o te hau, ka wehe koe hei utu te kawe i te 50 wharepaku ki tawhiti me nga ngakau e rua. HP ka whakahoutia ano ki te noa i roto i te 2 meneti.
power.neoorigins.slime_level_hp.name: Ko te Whakanui o te Gelatinous
power.neoorigins.slime_level_hp.descript: +1 HP mō ngā taumata 10 o te wheako.
power.neoorigins.slime_no_fall_damage.de: Kāore koe e whara i te hinganga ka peke koe.
